**Gateway on-call handoff — 2026-03-14 pool exhaustion**

**Root cause:** Deploy `dep-4471` (gateway, a.novak, "connection-per-request for pool isolation") flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true`. Each request began claiming its own DB connection instead of sharing the pool, exhausting the pool of 20.

**Impact window:** 02:14:18 UTC to at least 03:59:27 UTC (end of available log, still failing). Started 4 minutes after `dep-4471` finished deploying at 02:14. Every failure is `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`, 503s on `/v1/checkout`, `/v1/cart`, `/v1/session`, `/v1/catalog/search`, `/v1/orders`. The wait queue grew the whole time, from 13 queued requests early on to 74 by the last log line, with failing-request latency climbing from ~660ms to ~850ms.

**Rollback:** `dep-4471`. Revert `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `false`.

**Scope:** Gateway only. `worker.log` for the same window shows no errors, no 503s, no pool issues, just one unrelated slow-query warning at 02:36 tied to known issue `OPS-2210`.
